before.name: Kiki Garden
before.description: Kiki Garden was arrested during a Doña Ana County commission meeting about Project Jupiter on July 28, 2026. Reporting identifies them as an opponent of the data-center project. They were booked into the county detention center and released on their own recognizance the next morning after pleading not guilty.
